features.sentence: The Ig Nobel Prize went to research on nutrient-rich crystals that had been published earlier.

features.sentence: The researchers took out protein crystals containing nutrients from the gut of the unborn young.

features.sentence: It does not mean that drinking them would make people three times as energetic.

features.sentence_llm_raw: It does not mean that drinking them would make people three times as energetic.

features.sentence: What’s more interesting is the idea of turning nutrients into crystals and storing them away.
